The doctor, vet and aspirants were so nice and they listen to what i needed and they did it.was very understanding with my fur baby.

The Dr was dismissive in hearing imput from me as the pet owner to a degree l felt l was initially accused of possibly neglecting my senior cat .  l was attempting to explain to the Doctor my cat seem weak in his hind legs and lost weight. I  explained to the Doctor that l believe his ill health is due to my revolving order of senior cat food from Pet Smart was filled with the wrong cat food and that my elderly cat didn't eat for at least 2 days causing him to become weak .My cats (3 of them) stays in a large enclosure  with total coverage from the sun, they are fed every day fresh food and fresh water , there is one large fan and a smaller fan in the kennel  that run 24/7  . l let the cats  out of their enclosure when it is cooler at 6 and 8 pm. 2 days ago l let the cats out and noticed the oldest cat that l am speaking of did not come out as he usually do . I walked back to the kennel and he was sitting at the gate of the enclosure. I noticed he tried getting up but his back legs didn't support him which is why l made the vet appointment . I picked him up and brought him into the house. I gave him his snacks and water , he ate and drank some. In telling this to the Doctor  she insinuated the problem seemed as a long ongoing situation as if l was neglecting my elderly cat. I called my wife on speaker phone to have her explain to the Doctor that the cat was doing fine and walking the day before l took him to the Vet .l showed the Doctor a video from my home security cameras that my cat was fine walking around in the backyard . The doctor checked him out , gave him SQ fluids <300 mi , pain meds and prednisone. My wife went to Pet Smart and purchased his correct food and soft treats.He has been eating /drinking a lot and using his litter box (#1 & #2) as he always have.  He regained his strength and begin walking steady again . I will keep him in my home over the weekend.  I am still appreciative for the Doctor looking at my cat but  l won't be coming back .
Everyone was helpful and attentive and friendly! They helped my cat and examined her thoroughly. My cat seemed to trust them. She did not cry in fear at all.

First visit with my dog Rosie who is a very anxious/reactive rescue. I was there for yearly vaccines and nail clipping. Everything went great. They put us in a room immediately and the wait was short for tech Autumn. She was very nice and went over all the details w/me and pricing. The prices are higher than most, so that hurt a little (offered a senior discount), but everything else was really good. Clean, organized and everyone was very pleasant and helpful. When Rosie had a reaction to one of her vaccines (vomiting), I called to ask a few questions and they were anxious to help in any way. Luckily, she recovered by the evening. Dr Fernanda Lopez was the doctor we saw and worked very good w/my stressed out dog!

Dr. Nester, Angela and Alex treated my dog Pepper with lots of patience and love( she’s a very hyper lab).  The entire staff was super friendly and continued to give me updates on her status throughout the day.  They even checked on her the next day to see how she was feeling!  I will never take her to any other Veterinarian!   I highly recommend this place if you care about your pet❤️

Sincerely,
Rochelle and Pepper

My dog has been a patient here for 13 years, and until recently I never had any issues despite different veterinarians coming and going. Unfortunately, my experience with the current veterinarian has been extremely disappointing.

I brought my elderly dog in for a cough and sneezing. In the past, she was always prescribed antibiotics and cough syrup when needed. Due to her age and the fact that she had 21 teeth extracted, she cannot take pills easily. Despite explaining this, the veterinarian refused to prescribe liquid antibiotics and instead provided a prescription for cough medication.

When I took the prescription to the pharmacy, I was told it could not be filled because it was not written on the proper paperwork required for that medication. The alternative offered was four pills for $55 that needed to be cut in half and would only last eight days. I declined and was told cough syrup could be ordered instead.

After paying $355 for the visit and leaving without any medication, I called several times over the following months and was repeatedly told I would be notified when the medication arrived. Three months later, I called again and was informed they would no longer be ordering the cough syrup at all. When I requested a new prescription on the proper paperwork, I was told they did not have the required forms.

The level of communication and follow-through was unacceptable. In addition, prices have increased significantly since our previous visits. After 13 years as a loyal client, I am very disappointed with how this situation was handled and will be looking for another veterinarian.

Very professional and knowledgeable of laser procedure done on my Dachshund
Thank you

I wish I could leave a better review... because the vet here, Dr. Fernanda, is absolutely amazing. However, the manager is super unprofessional. In April, she called me to leave a vague message cancelling my pet's spay surgery with no explanation why. When I returned her call 10 minutes later, she was (surprisingly) already gone for the day. I asked the very polite receptionist to have her call me and she never did. Fast forward, over a month later, I called back to inquire if they were doing surgeries again, (because their vet is awesome) to be told no again without a known reason. I asked again to have her call me back and she finally did... a week later. She tried lying about returning my calls, telling me that doing surgeries were not in their best interest and then hung up. What a shame, her veterinarian is awesome, but the manager's unprofessionalism will keep clients away. I will choose to take my pets and my money to a vet clinic with a manager who actually knows how to interact with people.
Great vet, everyone was so nice and friendly and very helpful.

Very unfortunate that my kitten didn’t get any blood work done because she was “too feral” when she was actually a very sweet kitten. They didn’t do everything they could have done to save my kitten. Because they did not do the blood work, she went a couple days on her death bed. Ended up passing due to a congenital kidney disorder which would have been caught by a vet who is thorough and actually cares about the pets they see. I went back again for my other cat who had an asthma episode and she asked how my other cat was. Told the vet she passed and she showed no remorse nor afford any condolences. Would not recommend if you actually care for the life of your pet.

So now it's May of 2026 and I'm still taking my kitty to the Animal Beltway hospital because they do such a good job. So my biggest of 4 cats became diabetic. He started drinking water every hour. Then he started losing some pounds down to 12 lb.  I took him to get checked out. We ran tests and confirmed that this cat is diabetic. Furthermore, he needed to be put on insulin. So I'm limiting the treats only to dental treats. I'm also regulating his dry food and wet food. So now he eats less carbs.  We modified his insulin intake because he had a seizure.  The road to recovery is slow but I feel glad that I'm getting help when we need it.🩷🐈
